title: Choose starting-state and prove reset deliberately
when: Before scheduling QA that resets a host
need: A dedicated baseline needs golden capture plus restore proof, not just SSH or a saved archive. Verify/reset are destructive provisioning operations. No baseline is also a supported no-reset posture; an as_is case needs a reason. Capacity-machine registration is separate from test-machine registration.
surface: Per-OS capture/verify/reset; machine setting optional baseline; Pack starting-state contract.
gap: The entry guide must explain when a resettable rig is necessary. Do not make every browser user build a clean-install lab or mistake capacity registration for QA readiness.
